latest_cos_commentary.headline: Ingest is a small, New Orleans-based restaurant back-office/BI platform that unifies POS, inventory, vendor, and reservation data into one reporting layer.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Overlaps with Genius's back_office reporting/analytics ambitions; does not compete on POS or payments directly, instead sitting as a data-aggregation layer across whatever POS an operator already runs.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Small-scale (~$6.3M total raised); no major funding or customer announcements found as of research date.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: When a prospect mentions Ingest, clarify whether they're using it purely for cross-system reporting versus considering it as a broader operations platform — its scope is narrower than a full back-office suite like Restaurant365.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers, leadership names, or current pricing were found in sourceable material; company scale and market traction are largely unverified beyond aggregator-reported funding totals.
